title: The Torah - The Five Books of Moses
author: Jewish Publication Society
description: The Torah: The Five Books of Moses, the Jewish Publication Society's new translation of the Pentateuch according to the traditional Hebrew (Masoretic) text, first published in 1962 and later incorporated into the JPS Tanakh (1985). Prepared by a committee of scholars and rabbis led by Harry M. Orlinsky, it abandoned the King James tradition in favour of modern idiomatic English based on contemporary philology and Jewish exegesis, with notes on difficult readings. It contains Genesis (Bereshit), Exodus (Shemot), Leviticus (Vayikra), Numbers (Bamidbar) and Deuteronomy (Devarim): creation and the patriarchs, slavery and exodus from Egypt, the revelation at Sinai and the covenant, the tabernacle and priestly law, the wilderness journey, and Moses' farewell addresses. As the foundation of Judaism and source of Kabbalistic commentary, it underpins the library's Jewish mysticism holdings.
